tgt: The light you installed earlier is flickering every few seconds.
It's quite annoying, could you come back to take a look?
Are you free tomorrow morning to fix the wiring?
traps: Avoid 'The light is jumping.' Use 'flickering' to describe the light.
Avoid 'Can you come to look?' Say 'Could you come and check it?'
Avoid 'The light is broken.' Be more specific: 'The light is acting up' or 'It's flickering.'
talk_home_lamp_flicker.ai: 电工师傅，感到困惑，想了解具体闪烁的频率。
talk_home_lamp_flicker.task: 描述问题，并预约师傅回来检查。

tgt: The heating system in the living room is showing an error code, and the whole cabin is freezing cold.
I’m heading down to the basement right now to check the gas valve and circuit breaker like you said.
If we can't get the boiler to ignite by ourselves, are you able to send a maintenance person over tonight?
traps: 常说“The house is very cold, turn on the hot air.”，“hot air”指吹风机热风，暖气系统应用“heating system”或“furnace”。
常说“You need to fix this quickly.”，催促房东时语气过硬，地道说法应用“If we can't fix it, are you able to send someone over?”。
常说“I am going to the underground.”，“underground”作名词指地铁，地下室应用“basement”。
hob_ski_cabin_heating.ai: Alex 扮演木屋的房东。他刚跟家人吃完晚饭，接到你的电话后语气关切，正准备在电话里指导你如何手动重启地下室的燃气壁挂炉（Gas Boiler）。
hob_ski_cabin_heating.task: 描述室内温度极低的情况，按照房东在电话里的英文指令去地下室检查温控开关，并确认是否需要派维修工上门。

tgt: The car feels like it's struggling on these inclines. Should I be using a lower gear to keep the revs up?
Is it common for this model to lose power on steep climbs, or is it a transmission issue?
Could you show me how to manually shift properly without risking the engine?
traps: 说 'The car has no power' 太概括。应说 'The car feels sluggish on steep inclines'。
说 'I don't know how to drive this' 显得太笨。应说 'I'm not familiar with the manual override on this automatic transmission'。
说 'You tell me what to do' 语气像指挥。应说 'Could you share some tips on handling steep hills with this engine?'。
hob_car_mountain_climb.ai: 路过的资深自驾玩家。他认为这车排量太小，你用的是自动挡的D挡，他建议你切换手动模式换挡。
hob_car_mountain_climb.task: 理解为什么动力不足，并学会如何正确手动切换档位以维持动力

tgt: I’ve signed up for a six-month membership at a local gym to fix my back pain.
It cost me 350 dollars, but it’s totally worth it for the facilities they have.
Don't worry, I only go three times a week so I don't overexert myself.
traps: 说成 'I bought a gym card'，应为 'I signed up for a membership'，'buy a card' 听起来像是在买礼品卡。
说成 'It is for my back pain'，虽然没错但不够自然，建议用 'to fix my back pain' 或 'to help with my back issues'。
说成 'I go gym three times'，漏掉了 'to'，应为 'I go to the gym three times a week'。
soc_family_gym_membership.ai: Alex 是你的父亲，他很关心你的身体，会追问健身房是否安全、教练靠不靠谱、会不会太累。
soc_family_gym_membership.task: 说服父母你办卡是为了健康，并让他们放心。

tgt: Are your gluten-free pancakes prepared on a separate griddle to avoid wheat contamination?
Could you double-check the ingredient label on the pancake batter for any hidden wheat or barley?
If there's any risk of airborne flour in the kitchen, I'll just stick to the fruit bowl.
traps: 常说 "Does this have gluten flour inside?"，重复累赘，地道说法直接问 "Does this contain gluten?" 或 "Is this gluten-free?"。
常说 "My stomach cannot eat gluten"，语法没错但不够地道，日常表达乳糜泻或过敏会说 "I have a gluten intolerance" 或 "I have celiac disease"。
常说 "Separate the machine"，机器一般不用 machine，厨房设备烤盘或铁板地道说法是 "griddle" 或 "cooking surface"。
life_eat_gluten_free_inquiry.ai: Alex 扮演咖啡厅店员。他会热心解释店里的烘焙原料，并协助你挑选安全的替代选项。
life_eat_gluten_free_inquiry.task: 详细询问无麸质食材的具体成分及烹饪设备情况

tgt: This is much shorter than I requested. I specifically asked for just a trim.
I'm quite upset because I wanted to keep the length. I don't feel like myself with this cut.
Is there any way to fix this, or can we at least discuss a refund or a discount for this service?
traps: “You ruined my hair”虽然表达了心情，但过于激烈，建议用“This isn't what I had in mind”开头。
“I don't like it at all”显得有些拒人于千里之外，加上原因更地道：“I'm not happy with this result as it's way shorter than I wanted”。
“Give me money back”非常直白且生硬，建议用“Could we discuss a partial refund?”
life_emo_salon_mistake.ai: 理发师，觉得自己的审美很棒，认为你剪短了显得更有精神，所以有点自信过度。
life_emo_salon_mistake.task: 表达你的真实感受，说明这和你预期的差异巨大，并要求对方给个说法。

tgt: I tried to sleep, but the pillows tried to swallow me whole.
Are these pillows meant for sleeping or for a secret feather fight?
I think I need a snorkel just to survive sleeping on that bed.
traps: 容易说成 'The pillows are too soft and big.'，缺乏幽默感和画面感。
容易把‘吞没我’说成 'eat me'，用 'swallow me whole' 更有夸张的喜剧效果。
容易用 'Please change my pillows.' 变成严肃的客诉，而不是跟前台开玩笑。
talk_joke_hotel_pillow.ai: Alex 扮演酒店前台（通过电话回访）。他打电话询问入住感受，听到你的吐槽后顺势开个玩笑。
talk_joke_hotel_pillow.task: 向酒店前台开玩笑说这几个枕头像流沙或者准备‘绑架’你的头。

tgt: I am so terribly sorry for the noise last night; it was completely inconsiderate of me.
Please accept these macarons as a small gesture of my apology.
I’ve made sure to adjust my setup so it won’t happen again.
traps: 说成 'I give you this gift because I made noise'。这是陈述事实，显得很敷衍；应该用 'Please accept this as a small token of my apology'。
说成 'Sorry for my noise'。'My noise' 听起来很怪，像你是噪音源头；应该说 'Sorry for the disturbance' 或 'Sorry for being so loud'。
说成 'I hope you can forgive me'。在送礼场合这听起来有点道德绑架；应该用 'I really hope you can accept my apology' 更得体。
life_gift_neighbor_noise.ai: Alex 扮演邻居，他昨晚因为噪音没睡好，原本心情不太好，但看到你主动道歉，态度会有所缓和。
life_gift_neighbor_noise.task: 成功送出礼物并缓解邻居的情绪，避免被投诉到房东那里

tgt: Is this companion zine still available for purchase at the front desk?
Could I flip through the display copy for a moment before buying?
How many copies were printed for this limited run?
traps: 索要杂志说 Can I look at the sample book? 印刷品独立小册子一般叫 zine 或 booklet，而不是单纯的 sample book。
询问印数说 How many books did you print? zine 通常用 run 或 copies 来计量，说 print 显得不够专业。
询问购买说 Where can I buy this magazine? 独立出版的小册子用 zine 比 magazine 听起来更懂行。
hob_write_gallery_zine.ai: Alex 扮演美术馆前台。他会热情地拿出一本样刊给你翻看，并告诉你目前只在服务台出售，每本售价 18 美元。
hob_write_gallery_zine.task: 成功借阅样刊并问清购买渠道和价格，以便在文章中详细介绍

tgt: I'm sorry to hear that. Can I still place an order for takeaway?
What time do you officially close today?
Is the kitchen still taking orders for quick meals?
traps: 说成 'Can I eat fast?'，表达不地道，应使用 'Can I still place a quick order?'。
说成 'Why you close so early?'，显得不满，应改为 'I understand, will you be closing early due to the weather?'。
说成 'I want to pack my food'，不够礼貌，应使用 'Could I get my order as a takeaway, please?'。
life_wx_restaurant_roof.ai: Alex 扮演服务员。他表示抱歉，建议你尽快点餐或打包。
life_wx_restaurant_roof.task: 询问打包事宜或最后点餐时间

tgt: Use those oak logs for the roof trim first.
I'll teleport to the swamp biome to gather some dark wood.
Let's meet back at the storage chests when we're done.
traps: 把木头原木说成 'wooden materials'，游戏里具体的方块材料应该说 'oak logs'。
说‘去远处沼泽收集’说成 'go to far away swamp to collect'，地道表达是 'teleport to the swamp biome'。
说‘在储物箱见’说成 'meet at the box'，玩家之间习惯说 'storage chests'。
hob_video_minecraft_server.ai: Alex 扮演你的建筑搭子，他说他背包里还有一组橡木原木，问你要不要直接去伐木场砍一波树。
hob_video_minecraft_server.task: 让他先把木头拿来搭屋顶，然后你开传送门去远处沼泽收集其他建材

tgt: What would you recommend for a first-timer here?
What are your most popular dishes today?
Could you suggest something seafood-based that's really fresh?
traps: 容易说成 'What is best delicious food here?'。语法错误且词汇堆砌，'What is your most popular dish?' 更地道。
容易说成 'Recommend me something.'。句式不完整且命令语气太强，用 'What would you recommend...' 更好。
容易说成 'What do you want me to eat?'。听起来很怪，像是在问对方想吃什么，应用 'What do you suggest?'。
life_eat_ask_recommendation.ai: Alex 扮演服务员。他热情地向你推荐了当天的鲜活龙虾和招牌烤三文鱼。
life_eat_ask_recommendation.task: 请服务员推荐店里最受欢迎或者品质最好的两道菜

tgt: I am in room 1204, and the room Wi-Fi is not connecting.
It keeps saying authentication failed when I try to log in.
Is there an alternative network I can use?
traps: 词汇混淆：把 Wi-Fi 信号不好或连不上说成 'My internet is broken.' 略显夸张。地道说法是 'The Wi-Fi isn't working' 或 'I can't get online.'
介词误用：说成 'connect on the Wi-Fi'。正确的搭配是 'connect to the Wi-Fi'。
表达啰嗦：说成 'Can you give me another way to use the internet?'。地道简洁的说法是 'Is there an alternative network?'
talk_trip_hotel_wifi.ai: Alex 扮演前台接待员，会耐心听你描述问题，并提供备用网络连接方案。
talk_trip_hotel_wifi.task: 向前台说明 Wi-Fi 连不上，并拿到可用的上网密码或解决办法。

tgt: The meter reads 45 euros, so why is the total coming to 60?
Is there a fixed surcharge for luggage that I should be aware of?
I'd like to see the official fare table, please.
traps: 常说 'You are cheating me'，容易引发争吵，应说 'The fare seems different from what I expected'。
常说 'Why you charge so much?'，语法错误，应为 'Why are you charging this amount?'
常说 'Show me the rule'，不如 'Could you point out the extra charge on the fare list?' 更专业。
talk_story_overcharged_taxi.ai: Alex 是出租车司机，他坚称这是公司的规定，试图让你支付额外费用。
talk_story_overcharged_taxi.task: 询问额外费用的明细，并出示你之前的行程记录或询问当地规定以拒绝不合理收费。

tgt: What is the procedure for getting my security deposit back?
When can I expect to receive the deposit after I move out?
Will there be a final inspection of the apartment?
traps: 说成 'When can I get my money back?'。'Security deposit' 是专业术语，必须用上。
说成 'How to return the deposit?'。这听起来像是在问你怎么还钱给房东，应问 'How is the deposit returned'。
说成 'Will you check the room?'。'Inspection' 是租房退房的标准说法。
life_rent_negotiate_deposit.ai: Alex 是房东，他确认只要房屋完好，押金会在退房后 7 个工作日内通过转账退还。

tgt: Excuse me, which queue should I join for a taxi to Ginza?
Do I need to take a specific taxi for downtown Tokyo?
Is this the right line for regular taxis?
traps: 说成 'Which line should I stand?'。'stand' 后面少介词 in，地道说法是 'Which queue/line should I join?'。
把队伍叫成 'queue' 时发音错误或者直接用 'row'。排队买票或坐车用 'queue'（英式）或 'line'（美式），'row' 指横排。
问去哪儿说 'Which taxi goes to Ginza?'。直接问车有点奇怪，问“排哪条队去银座”用 'Which queue is for...?' 更好。
life_way_taxi_queue.ai: Alex 扮演现场的出租车引导员。他穿着反光背心，会指引你去正确的车道排队去市中心。
life_way_taxi_queue.task: 向引导员确认去银座应该排哪条队

tgt: Hey, do you want to sing a duet with me?
I love this song! Would you be up for singing it together?
We could give it a try if you're interested.
traps: 说成 'Sing with me'，像命令，用 'Would you be up for...' 更像是在询问朋友意见。
说成 'Do you like to sing?'，太宽泛，用 'sing a duet' 明确指代合唱。
说成 'Let's sing'，太随意，加上 'if you're interested' 显得更有礼貌。
hob_sing_duet_invitation.ai: Alex是你的朋友，他很乐意，并说正好想练练这首歌。
hob_sing_duet_invitation.task: 提出合唱邀请并确认对方意愿

tgt: My current subscription is sending me more coffee than I can consume.
Could I switch to a monthly delivery instead of bi-weekly?
If changing the frequency isn't possible, what are my options for pausing the subscription?
traps: 说成 'I want to cancel the coffee.' 容易产生歧义。建议用 'modify' 或 'adjust' 描述你的需求。
说成 'Every two weeks' 容易混淆。用 'bi-weekly' 需确认对方理解，或者直接说 'every other week'。
说成 'I have too much coffee.' 表达比较被动。说 'I'm accumulating too much coffee' 会更地道。
hob_coffee_subscription_cancellation.ai: 客服，表示系统设定较死板，建议你先跳过下个月的配送，或者尝试转为更小包装的套餐。
hob_coffee_subscription_cancellation.task: 成功修改订阅计划而不被系统强制锁定

tgt: I only grazed it to check the stability, I did not start pulling yet.
The rule says you must play the piece you pull, but I did not pull it.
Let us just agree that my turn continues with the block on the left.
traps: 容易说成『I just touch it to see, not pulling.』，时态和动词混用，地道说法是『I only grazed it to check the stability, I did not start pulling yet.』
容易说成『Rule says you pull what you touch.』，漏掉冠词和从句引导词，地道说法是『The rule says you must play the piece you pull...』
容易说成『Let us say my turn goes on with left block.』，表达不够地道，地道说法是『Let us just agree that my turn continues with the block on the left.』
hob_chess_jenga_touch_6852.ai: 奥利弗，坐在你旁边的好友。他严格遵守摸牌即落子无悔的桌游习惯，认为你刚才触碰木块的动作已经生效了。
hob_chess_jenga_touch_6852.task: 向奥利弗解释你刚才只是试探性调整手指，并未开始正式抽拉，因此不算违规

tgt: I'd honestly prefer the original Swedish audio with English subtitles, because dubbed versions usually lose all the subtle emotional nuances.
The actors' real vocal delivery is such a huge part of the suspense, even if we have to read subtitles the whole time.
If you don't mind, let's give the original track ten minutes, and we can always switch to dubbing if it's too distracting.
traps: 说‘微妙的情感’直译成 'small feeling'。地道说法是 'subtle emotional nuances'。
说‘演员的真实原声’用 'actors' real voice'。地道说法是 'actors' real vocal delivery'。
说‘如果太让人分心’用 'if it makes you lost focus'。地道说法是 'if it's too distracting.'。
talk_movie_subtitles_vs_dubbing.ai: Alex 扮演你的法国房东。他英语很好，只是觉得看原声片盯着字幕太累，更习惯看配音版，但听到你的坚持后非常愿意配合。
talk_movie_subtitles_vs_dubbing.task: 向 Alex 解释为什么原声配音更有戏剧张力和情感爆发力，请求保留带英文字幕的原声版。

tgt: Thank you for sharing your umbrella with me; you really saved me from the rain.
I have these throat lozenges and I’d love for you to have them as a thank you.
You were so thoughtful to stop and help me.
traps: 不要说'I give you this because you share umbrella'，应说'Thank you for sharing your umbrella, please accept this'。
不要说'You are a good person'，太像评价，应说'That was so thoughtful of you'。
不要说'I owe you'，除非你想表达深层关系，否则用'I really appreciate it'。
soc_thanks_shared_umbrella.ai: 路人，觉得共伞没多大麻烦，不想让你太在意。
soc_thanks_shared_umbrella.task: 赞美对方的体贴，并坚持送出润喉糖。

tgt: I'm comfortable riding in a double paceline and taking my turn at the front.
Could you remind me of your group's specific hand signals for road hazards?
What's the expected regrouping point if someone gets dropped on the climbs?
traps: 把双人轮流领骑直译成 double people riding。地道说法是 double paceline。
把掉队说成 someone is lost。在骑行社群里，掉队的标准动词是 get dropped。
说成 lead the front。领骑的标准搭配是 take a pull 或 take your turn at the front。
hob_bike_group_ride_join.ai: Alex，俱乐部资深领骑。他性格友好但对安全要求严格，会提醒你注意跟车距离和手势信号。
hob_bike_group_ride_join.task: 向 Alex 说明你以前有丰富的大集团骑行经验，并确认自己能跟上均速。

tgt: I just bought this milk, but it expired three days ago.
Could I get a fresh one, please?
Can I exchange this for a bottle with a later date?
traps: 说成 'This milk is old.' 语义不明，应说 'expired'。
说成 'Can I change?' 动词不准确，应说 'exchange'。
说成 'The date is wrong.' 对方会以为是打印错误，应说 'The expiration date has passed'。
life_food_expired_milk.ai: Alex 是超市工作人员，他会向你道歉，并带你去冷柜区换一桶新的。
life_food_expired_milk.task: 指出牛奶已过期，要求更换。

tgt: Is the tree straight from your side?
Let's shovel the soil in slowly while you hold the trunk.
Should we stamp the soil down gently when we finish?
traps: Say 'Is tree straight?'。漏掉冠词和系动词，应说 'Is the tree straight?'。
Say 'Put soil in now?'。太口语化，地道表达是 'Let's shovel the soil in slowly'。
Say 'Step on soil?'。'Step on' 听起来像踩踏破坏，轻踩压实土壤用 'stamp down' 或 'pat down'。
hob_volunteer_tree_planting.ai: Alex 是和你搭档的另一位志愿者，负责扶着树苗。他笑着跟你确认埋土的深度。
hob_volunteer_tree_planting.task: 和搭档确认树苗是否扶正以及何时填土

tgt: Excuse me, I bought these strawberries earlier and found some were moldy at the bottom.
I’m afraid these aren't in good condition. Can I get a refund or a fresh box?
Would you mind checking this? There's some mold on these.
traps: 说成 'This strawberry is bad.'，用词过于笼统，'moldy'（发霉）或 'not fresh' 更具体。
说成 'Give me my money back.'，语气过于强硬，建议使用 'Could I get a refund?'。
说成 'I found broken ones.'，'broken' 通常指物体损坏，水果不新鲜应用 'in bad condition' 或 'spoiled'。
life_shop_fruit_quality.ai: 超市收银员，态度诚恳，表示可以直接退款或重选一盒。
life_shop_fruit_quality.task: 说明情况并要求退款或更换

tgt: Do you want me to dig this section about two inches deeper?
Should the slope face toward the treeline to drain properly?
I'll use the shovel to level out the bottom right now.
traps: 说成 'Dig deeper?' 太简略，地道说法应用 'Do you want me to dig this section about two inches deeper?'
说成 'Where water go?' 语气不够礼貌专业，地道说法应用 'Should the slope face toward the treeline to drain properly?'
说成 'I fix bottom.' 表达生硬，地道说法应用 'I'll use the shovel to level out the bottom right now.'
hob_volunteer_trail_maintenance.ai: Alex 是带队护林员，他会拿着量尺跟你解释标准的水流引导坡度，避免雨水再次冲毁步道。
hob_volunteer_trail_maintenance.task: 理解护林员的要求，并重新调整排水沟的深度和坡度

tgt: I'm looking for something with a fuller body that pairs well with milk.
The acidic notes are interesting, but I prefer a chocolatey or nutty profile for my morning latte.
What would you recommend if I'm after a bolder, more classic espresso taste?
traps: Avoid 'I want coffee for milk', say 'I'm looking for something that pairs well with milk' to sound like a pro.
Don't say 'This is too sour', say 'I'm not a huge fan of high acidity' to sound more subjective and polite.
Instead of 'Give me the strongest one', say 'I prefer a bolder flavor profile' to use correct coffee terminology.
talk_food_coffee_bean.ai: 店员，资深咖啡师。他非常执着于豆子的酸度分级，而你更想找一种适合加牛奶的醇厚风味。
talk_food_coffee_bean.task: 向店员解释你的偏好，并让他推荐一款适合做拿铁的豆子

tgt: Do you mind if I plug my guitar in to test it?
Does it make any unwanted buzzing noise?
I will take it, here is 60 cash.
traps: 请求试用说 'Can I try it?'。缺乏具体动作，地道说法是 'Do you mind if I plug in and test the sound?'。
问有没有杂音说 'Does it have bad sound?'。杂音在音乐器材里的专业词是 buzzing noise 或 hum，不说 bad sound。
买下付钱说 'I buy it, take money.' 语法错误，地道成交短语是 'I'll take it. Here's your cash.'。
hob_collect_buy_used_guitar_amp.ai: Alex 扮演卖家，笑着把电吉他和连接线递给你，让你随便插上试音。
hob_collect_buy_used_guitar_amp.task: 试用音箱并确认功能完好

tgt: That must have been really frustrating when you were in a rush.
People really need to be more mindful of shared spaces.
Anyway, I'm just hoping my load finishes before the rain starts.
traps: 使用 'He wasted your time so much'，直译导致表达啰嗦且语气过于重。地道说法是 'That really wasted your time' 或 'That must have been frustrating'。
使用 'You should tell him face to face directly'，语法虽然对但语气像在下达命令。地道劝说用 'Maybe you could leave a polite note next time'。
使用 'Shared space needs everyone to respect'，中式语法痕迹重。地道表达是 'Everyone needs to respect shared spaces' 或 'We all share this space'。
soc_gossip_laundry_room_6914.ai: Alex是住在同栋楼的邻居，性格随和但有点爱抱怨。他的立场是希望你能共情他的遭遇，顺便一起维持洗衣房的公序良俗。
soc_gossip_laundry_room_6914.task: 既不显得冷漠，也不跟着过度八卦，礼貌且适度地回应对方的抱怨。

tgt: I'm so sorry, I wasn't aware that this specific area was a no-fly zone.
Could you please point me toward a nearby area where drone flight is permitted?
I'd love to capture some footage safely. Is there a local map or app you'd recommend?
traps: 说成 'I didn't know the rule'，像是在找借口。用 'I wasn't aware that...' 更客观。
说成 'Where can I fly?'，太直接。用 'Could you please point me toward...' 更有礼貌。
说成 'Is it legal to fly here?'，对方已经明确指出违法，不用再问。应改为 'Where is it permitted?'
hob_photo_drone_no_fly_zone.ai: 警员，礼貌但坚定地要求你收起无人机，并提到如果你在附近区域起飞，可能会面临罚款。
hob_photo_drone_no_fly_zone.task: 诚恳道歉，并询问是否有附近的合法航拍点可以推荐。

tgt: My pet is on a strict vet prescription diet, so we can't try new food.
Thanks, but we are completely stocked up on pet food right now.
I'm heading out now. Have a nice day.
traps: 使用 'My dog cannot eat your food'，语气过于直接生硬，地道表达应用 'My pet is on a strict vet prescription diet'。
Use 'I have enough food at home'，虽然能懂但不够地道，地道表达应用 'We are completely stocked up on pet food right now'。
使用 'Stop following me with the bag'，容易引起不必要的误会，地道表达应用 'I'm heading out now. Have a nice day' 直接结束。
life_no_pet_food.ai: Alex 扮演宠物食品推销员。他会问你养的是什么狗，并夸奖你的狗很可爱，然后推销那袋25美金的试用装。
life_no_pet_food.task: 告诉对方你的宠物有特殊饮食不能乱吃，拒绝购买并抽身离开。

tgt: I'm sorry to bother you, but the vibration and exhaust from your generator are coming directly into my bedroom.
Could we perhaps move the generator to a different spot, or limit its use during the late night hours?
I completely understand you need power, but I'm struggling with the noise and fumes. How can we work this out?
traps: 说成 'Your generator is killing me'，过于夸张，应说 'The noise is really affecting my sleep.'
说成 'Stop using it'，太无理，应说 'Could we explore a compromise, such as moving it further away?'
说成 'You are a bad neighbor'，人身攻击，应专注于问题：'I’d really appreciate it if we could find a way to minimize the impact.'
life_wx_neighbor_noise.ai: Alex是你的邻居，他认为这是停电期间的必要工具，且他有小孩需要供暖，态度很强硬。
life_wx_neighbor_noise.task: 劝说邻居调整发电机位置，或寻求一个彼此都能接受的方案。

tgt: I am so sorry! That was an accidental attachment.
Please ignore my previous email. Here is the correct file.
Sorry for the mix-up.
traps: 避免说 'I sent the wrong one'，最好具体点，应说 'I attached the wrong file by mistake'。
避免说 'Don't look at it'，太生硬，应说 'Please ignore the previous attachment'。
避免说 'It is not my fault, the computer is wrong'，应诚实说 'I am sorry for the confusion'。
soc_sorry_email_mistake.ai: Alex 是房东，他回复邮件说收到了一张奇怪的照片，询问是否发错了。
soc_sorry_email_mistake.task: 向房东道歉，并重新发送正确文件。

tgt: He's gorgeous! What's his name?
She's a rescue, so we aren't entirely sure of her exact mix.
It's definitely a handful, but totally worth it, right?
traps: 夸狗时说 'Your dog is very smart and nice.'。nice 用来形容狗略显生硬，形容狗友好、温顺通常用 friendly 或 sweet。
回答狗的年龄时说 'It is three years old.'。对宠物通常用 he 或 she 而不是 it，显得更亲切，说成 'She is three.' 更好。
谈到遛狗辛苦时说 'Walking dog every day is tired.'。主语动名词短语作主语应搭配主动含义的 tiring，说成 'Walking the dog every day can be pretty tiring.' 才是地道英语。
soc_small_neighborhood_dog.ai: Alex 扮演热情的宠物主人。他会先介绍自家狗的名字和脾气，并反问你养的是什么品种、多大了。
soc_small_neighborhood_dog.task: 赞美对方的狗，回答对方的提问，并聊两句养狗的心得

tgt: I’ve tried to resolve the noise issue with my neighbor directly, but they continue to play loud music until 2 AM.
This recurring noise is a violation of the building’s quiet hours, and I need your intervention.
Could you please issue a formal warning to the tenant in unit 402?
traps: 不要说 'The neighbor makes a big sound'，应用 'The neighbor is being noisy' 或 'playing loud music'。
不要说 'You must tell him'，语气太强硬，应说 'I would appreciate it if you could address this'。
不要说 'It is not quiet here'，地道说法是 'It is violating the quiet hours'。
life_rent_noisy_neighbor.ai: 房东 Alex。他不想卷入租客之间的矛盾，希望你尽量自己解决，除非事情闹得很大。
life_rent_noisy_neighbor.task: 向房东说明严重性，要求他介入，并提供具体的时间节点证据。

tgt: I’m sorry I wasn't completely honest. I was feeling quite burnt out and just needed a quiet night.
It wasn’t about avoiding you, I just really needed some alone time to recharge.
I value our friendship, I just handle social exhaustion in a way I didn't know how to explain.
traps: 说 'It’s none of your business'，破坏友谊，应说 'I apologize for not being direct with you'。
说 'You are too sensitive'，攻击对方感受，应说 'I understand why you felt that way'。
说 'I lied because I had to'，显得狡辩，应说 'I was afraid you wouldn't understand my need for solitude'。
talk_cul_invitation_refusal.ai: Alex 是你的朋友，他认为友谊中必须绝对坦诚，对你撒谎感到伤心和困惑。
talk_cul_invitation_refusal.task: 真诚解释自己的社交需求，修复因“白谎”造成的误会。

tgt: It's not just about the buckle; the boot width is clearly not right for my foot shape.
If you can't provide a replacement, I’d like to request a partial refund for the rental.
I'm losing circulation in my feet, so continuing to ski in these is not an option.
traps: 说成 'My feet are dead' 很吓人，说 'losing circulation' 描述医学感受更准确。
说成 'Change the shoes' 比较随意，使用 'provide a replacement' 更正式。
说成 'Give me money back' 很粗鲁，说 'request a partial refund' 是正确的商务表达。
hob_ski_rented_boots.ai: 店员。他建议你把鞋扣解松一点滑，觉得换鞋是不可能的。
hob_ski_rented_boots.task: 坚持这不仅仅是松紧问题，是鞋楦（Last）宽度不匹配，要求他们提供其他型号或退还部分租金。

tgt: A going concern assessment needs to be supported by a cash flow forecast for at least the next twelve months.
We'd also need a written commitment from the shareholder to confirm the funding support.
Without the forecast and the written commitment, we may need to consider the impact on our conclusion.
traps: "We need you to do a cash flow forecast." — do a forecast 偏口语。地道："We need you to prepare a cash flow forecast."

"Shareholder's verbal promise cannot support going concern." — verbal promise 应为 verbal commitment/undertaking 更正式；cannot support 直译略生硬。地道："A verbal commitment alone doesn't support the going concern assessment."
"If no cash flow forecast provided, we cannot sign the report." — "If no...provided" 是不完整从句、中式英语；cannot sign 语气过强。地道："If a forecast isn't provided, we may not be able to finalize the report on time."
aud_evid_going_concern.ai: Alex 扮演客户财务总监(CFO)。他认为股东口头承诺注资是事实、报表附注已披露，做现金流预测耗时且假设易被质疑。他先说明股东会支持，再质疑预测的必要性。
aud_evid_going_concern.task: 向CFO说明持续经营评估需有现金流预测和股东书面承诺支撑，要求其提供未来12个月现金流预测及注资承诺函。

tgt: With only 12 million of cash domestically and 35 million of debt due in Q3, the group is reliant on repatriating funds from the overseas subsidiary.
Repatriation is subject to regulatory approval with no defined timeline — has the application actually been approved, or is it still pending?
If the approval slips beyond Q3, the group won't have sufficient liquidity to meet the debt maturity, which could cast significant doubt on going concern.
traps: 「The money cannot come back」直译「钱回不来」，come back 不专业；资金汇回用 repatriate / remit funds，地道说法是 funds cannot be repatriated in time。
「The country controls foreign exchange」直译且笼统；专业说法是 the country has imposed foreign exchange controls / capital controls，或 funds are subject to exchange controls。
「We don't know when it can be approved」直译「不知道什么时候能批」，when it can be approved 语法别扭；地道说法是 there is no defined timeline for approval / the approval timeline is uncertain。
aud_gc_repatriation_block.ai: Alex 扮演客户资金总监。他先解释汇回申请已提交、预计能获批，但也承认没有确定时间表。他希望你把这视为临时性管制，不要据此质疑持续经营。
aud_gc_repatriation_block.task: 评估资金汇回的时间与确定性，判断境内现金是否足以覆盖到期债务，确认是否构成重大不确定性。

tgt: Moving the count to the 28th means we'll need a roll-forward to year-end.
We can do it, but it adds cut-off procedures on both sides of the count.
Could you walk me through the stock movements between the 28th and year-end?
traps: “做盘点”说 do inventory count —— 漏冠词且偏中式；实地盘点叫 physical inventory count / stocktake，动词说 conduct the stocktake / count the inventory。
“差三天不影响”说 the three days difference doesn't matter —— difference 后缺介词且 matter 太口语；应说 a three-day gap / three days won't make a material difference。
“把盘点roll forward”说 roll forward the count —— 动宾搭错；正确是 roll forward the inventory / do a roll-forward from the count date to year-end。
aud_plan_stock_count_date.ai: Alex 扮演客户财务总监。他确实有物流调度压力（元旦前要发货），认为差三天不影响审计、盘点方法不变；他没意识到截止调整的麻烦，态度是配合但希望按他的日期。
aud_plan_stock_count_date.task: 把提前盘点对时间表和程序的影响讲清楚，明确若提前则客户需配合的截止调整与额外程序。

tgt: Could you walk me through how you assessed going concern at the FY25 reporting date, given the covenant breach?
Just so I can frame our 9M26 review, what information did you have at the time on the refinancing?
I'm not second-guessing the conclusion — I'd just like to understand the basis so our opening balances work stays consistent.
traps: 说成 “I want to know your basis”——“want to know” 直译“我想知道”，语气像在审问；地道说法用 “I'd like to understand the basis” 或 “Could you walk me through the basis”。
说成 “according to my understanding”——中式英语；“根据我的了解”地道说法是 “as I understand it” 或 “my understanding is that…”。“according to” 用于引述标准或权威来源（如 according to HKAS 1），不用于引述自己的理解。
说成 “did you make a conclusion”——“make a conclusion” 是中式搭配；结论应搭配 “reach / draw / arrive at a conclusion”。
aud_oa_going_concern_eom.ai: Alex 扮演前任审计合伙人。他愿意解释当时的评估逻辑：违约是事实，再融资当时还在谈，故提强调事项是恰当的。他希望把当时的时点判断讲清楚，不希望被暗示当时的结论有偏差。
aud_oa_going_concern_eom.task: 取得前任对 FY25 持续经营评估的依据说明，明确当时可得信息的边界，用于支撑 9M26 期初判断。

tgt: Remote access to the financial system is still on username and password only, with no MFA.
That's a deviation from the group security policy, which requires MFA for remote access.
Can you walk me through the interim controls before MFA goes live?
traps: “没有双因素”直译成 There is no double factor——double factor 不地道；固定说法是 two-factor authentication (2FA) 或 multi-factor authentication (MFA)。
说 It deviates the policy——deviate 是不及物动词，须接 from，应说 it deviates from the policy，或更常用 it's a deviation from the policy。
说 Please open MFA as soon as possible——open 不搭配 authentication；“启用”应说 enable / roll out MFA，且 as soon as possible 偏催促，宜配 a target date。
aud_it_mfa_vpn.ai: Alex 扮演客户IT基础设施负责人，负责VPN。他配合、坦诚：知道政策要求，但解释说MFA项目排在FY27Q1、因为要采购令牌、涉及预算审批，想和审计确认这个gap能否先用“VPN仅限白名单IP”过渡、等MFA上线。
aud_it_mfa_vpn.task: 向IT负责人确认MFA缺失是一个policy deviation，了解他的过渡方案，并明确这个gap需要在管理建议书里反映、不能仅靠口头承诺关闭。

tgt: The client’s CFO has requested a 1.5-hour special meeting this Thursday afternoon to discuss foreign exchange compliance for their overseas subsidiary.
I need to prepare materials 1 day in advance and have two internal review meetings already scheduled for that day.
Could we reschedule the internal meetings or coordinate with the legal team to join the client call?
traps: 说"I have a meeting that day"，过于简略，地道表达应该说明会议的具体内容和时长，比如"I have two 1-hour internal review meetings scheduled for Thursday afternoon"。
直接要求对方调整会议，语气过于强硬，地道表达应该用协商的"could we reschedule"或"would it be possible to"。
只提会议需求不提客户的重要性，显得不够专业，地道表达应该先说明客户的身份和会议的核心议题。
wk_boss_approve_client_meeting_request.ai: 你的行政合伙人Tom，他会先确认你当前的日程优先级，再帮你协调会议时间，不会直接拒绝你的申请。
wk_boss_approve_client_meeting_request.task: 向Tom申请调整本周四的内部复核会议时间，或申请批准召开本次客户专项会议，并请求协调法务团队同步参会

tgt: Can you provide the list of the unpaid invoices and the corresponding lease agreements?
Could you share the follow-up plan with the landlords to obtain the compliant VAT invoices?
I need to calculate the potential tax adjustment amount due to the missing invoices.
traps: Saying "your invoices are invalid" is accusatory; a more professional way is "We found that some rental payments do not have compliant VAT invoices, which may affect tax deductibility".
Using "get" instead of "obtain" when talking about formal financial documents is too casual; the correct term is "obtain compliant invoices".

Forgetting to mention the tax impact is a common mistake; instead of just talking about invoices, you should clearly state "these un-invoiced payments cannot be deducted for corporate income tax purposes".
dd_lease_check_invoice_compliance.ai: Alex是标的公司的税务专员，他会解释部分房东无法提供发票，正在跟进补开流程，愿意提供后续的发票获取计划。
dd_lease_check_invoice_compliance.task: 确认未合规发票的租金支出的税务影响，评估潜在的税务风险。

tgt: Could you explain the purpose of the "social insurance subsidy" line item on the payroll?
I’ve observed that a large portion of your sales team receives a monthly subsidy matching the statutory social insurance personal contribution amount. Can you clarify this?
Could you share the internal policy that governs this subsidy payment?
traps: Using "cash subsidy" without specifying the context is vague, use "cash-based social insurance subsidy" for clarity.
Saying "this is illegal" is too strong, use neutral investigative language like "this practice may require further clarification against local statutory requirements" instead.
Translating "变相替代" directly as "replace instead" is incorrect, use "circumvent the statutory requirement of paying social insurance directly" for accurate professional meaning.
dd_bank_social_subsidy.ai: Alex是公司薪酬经理，他的立场是配合尽调，希望解释设置该补贴的初衷，配合提供相关的薪酬制度文件。
dd_bank_social_subsidy.task: 核实该社保补贴是否属于变相替代法定社保缴纳的情况

tgt: Our 9M26 cross-border supplier payment project involves £5.8M in goods, and the current GBP exchange rate fluctuation has reached 4.2%, so we need to lock the exchange rate for 3 months to avoid exchange loss risks.
I’ve already prepared a detailed risk assessment report showing the potential loss if we don’t lock the exchange rate, and I’ve shared it with your team this morning.
Could we temporarily unlock part of the monthly exchange rate locking quota for this project given the significant exchange rate fluctuation?
traps: Saying "we need to lock the exchange rate" is too direct and doesn’t explain the risk, you should state the specific fluctuation range and potential loss first.
Using "you have to give me the quota" is too authoritative and ignores the company’s policies, the natural phrasing is "could we find a way to accommodate this urgent need".
Forgetting to mention the prepared risk report makes the other team think you haven’t done your due diligence, which is a common mistake in professional English requests.
wk_res_currency_exchange_resource.ai: 资金部主管Luna，她的立场是需要遵守公司的月度汇率锁定额度政策，担心额外解锁额度会违反财务风控要求。
wk_res_currency_exchange_resource.task: 说服Luna临时解锁部分汇率锁定额度，同时提供项目的风险评估报告

tgt: Congratulations on your new career opportunity – we’re glad to hear the news.
Could we schedule a handover call with your replacement next week to walk through the data validation criteria?
We’ll conduct a final quality check on the completed data sets by Oct 25 to ensure alignment with our compliance standards.
traps: You can’t leave until we finish the work. 过于强硬且不尊重对方职业选择，地道说法应为We want to ensure a smooth transition for the remaining data整理工作 and appreciate your support through the handover.
Your replacement won’t know what to do. 属于消极且不专业的表达，地道说法应为We’ve prepared a detailed handover manual to support your successor with the project.
We will cancel the contract if you leave. 属于威胁式表达不合适，地道说法应为We value our partnership with your company and are looking forward to continuing our collaboration.
wk_exit_outsourcing_vendor.ai: Alex是外包供应商对接人李先生，他的立场是希望能顺利完成现有数据整理项目的交接，同时希望能和新的对接人交接所有的项目细节。
wk_exit_outsourcing_vendor.task: 和李先生确认项目交接的时间节点，安排己方团队和他的继任者对接，确保所有数据整理工作在11月10日前完成并通过审核。

tgt: That works perfectly for me, thanks so much for fixing it quickly.
I totally get you’re swamped right now, so this new cup would be great.
No worries at all, just make sure it’s nice and icy this time around.
traps: 说"I very agree with you"，very不能修饰agree，地道说法是"I totally agree with you"或者"That works for me"。
直译"我同意你重新做"说成"I agree you remake it"，正确搭配是"I agree to your idea of remaking it"或者直接用"That works"。
用"Yes, you must remake it"语气太强硬，不符合和店员沟通的轻松语域，应该用更委婉的"That would be great"。
talk_agree_cafe_waiter.ai: Alex是当班的店员，他看到你回来后连忙道歉，说刚才太忙忘了加冰，提出可以帮你重新做一杯。
talk_agree_cafe_waiter.task: 委婉同意店员重新做一杯的提议，同时表达自己赶时间的小困扰

tgt: Hey, my chain just fell off, could you help me fix it real quick?
How much do you charge for this service?
Thanks so much for your help, here's the fee.
traps: 说"My chain is broken"，实际只是脱落并非断裂，属于错误描述，地道说法应该是"my chain just fell off"
直接报出价格要求，应该先礼貌询问费用再决定是否接受，中式直接表达不符合场景
用"You must fix it quickly"，语气太强硬，应该用"could you help me fix it real quick"更委婉自然
hob_bike_bridge_check.ai: Alex是流动修车师傅，随身带齐全套修车工具，会帮你处理掉链问题，按次收取小额服务费。
hob_bike_bridge_check.task: 让师傅快速修好链条，支付合理费用后继续骑行。

tgt: Could you help me replace the lost locker key for locker 307?
How much is the replacement fee for the locker key?
What should I do if I find the old key later?
traps: I very want to replace my locker key.  这句用了中式思维的“very want”，地道表达应该是“I’d like to replace my locker key”或者更自然的“Could you help me replace the lost locker key?”
I pay 12 euro.  欧元的正确复数形式是euros，应该说“I’ll pay 12 euros”或者直接配合店员的说法“The replacement fee is 12 euros”
You know, my key is lost.  这种表述太啰嗦，口语里直接说“My locker 307 key is lost”就足够自然，不需要额外加“You know”这类冗余铺垫
hob_swim_pool_frontdesk.ai: 前台服务员卡洛斯，他会先核对你的会员信息，然后告诉你补办钥匙需要支付12欧元的工本费，还会提醒你如果旧钥匙被找到不能再使用。
hob_swim_pool_frontdesk.task: 顺利补办储物柜钥匙，确认新钥匙可以正常使用，同时问清楚如果找回旧钥匙该怎么处理。

tgt: Hi, I had a private swimming lesson booked for 3pm today, but the pool is closed.
Could you reschedule my booking for the same time tomorrow?
Is there any way to get a small discount on my next lesson?
traps: 说"The pool is broken"太笼统，应该具体说明"The pool is closed for pipe repairs"让对方清楚情况。
用"You must reschedule for me"语气太强，应该用"Could you please reschedule my booking?"来表达请求。
直接问"Can you give me a discount"太突兀，应该用更委婉的"Is there any way to get a discount on my next lesson?"更自然。
life_gym_pool_closed.ai: Alex是泳池当班救生员，他会告诉你维修大概要到第二天早上才能结束，已经有5位顾客过来取消预约了，他可以帮你重新预约明天同一时段的课程。
life_gym_pool_closed.task: 让救生员帮你把预约改到明天下午3点，同时询问是否有额外的补偿措施。

tgt: Can you provide the written confirmation from the landlord regarding the renewal intent?
Let’s review the original lease terms to confirm the renewal option terms.
Could you walk me through your assessment of the reasonably certain threshold for lease renewal?
traps: 直译"优先续租条款"为"first right to renew"，地道的专业说法是"optional renewal term"
用"sure"来回应确认，专业场景下应该用"confirmed in writing"来强化证据的有效性
误用"depreciation"指代使用权资产的摊销，正确的术语是"amortization of right-of-use assets"，符合HKFRS 16的规范
aud_est_lease_renewal.ai: Alex是客户的租赁主管，他说明这两处场地的租赁合同都有优先续租条款，公司已经和业主口头确认会续约。
aud_est_lease_renewal.task: 和租赁主管沟通续租权假设的合理性，核对HKFRS 16的相关要求

tgt: I noticed the wooden beams look newer than the rest of the structure, that’s exactly what you’re talking about.
The tourist info said they used traditional materials, but maybe some parts had to be replaced?
Do you know how often these heritage sites get major repairs done here?
traps: 说"I not know"，语法错误，正确是"I don’t know"或者"I’m not sure"。
把"日本廊桥"直译成"Japan bridge"，地道译法是"Japanese Covered Bridge"。
用"You must be right"这种过于绝对的表达，更自然的是"That sounds about right"。
talk_history_vietnam_hoian_ancient_town.ai: Alex是韩国来的越南古代贸易史研究者，他正在跟你吐槽廊桥的修复工程破坏了 original architectural details，他觉得修复团队用了现代材料。
talk_history_vietnam_hoian_ancient_town.task: 和Alex就廊桥修复问题展开友好交流，了解更多古城保护的细节，保持轻松的对话氛围。

tgt: I bought this vanilla ice cream 10 minutes ago at your checkout counter, but it’s already completely melted because the freezer in the dairy section stopped working.
I’d like to get a full refund for this ice cream, and I also think I should get some compensation for the inconvenience this caused.
Can you please check the other items I bought to make sure they weren’t damaged by the freezer outage?
traps: Saying "the freezer is broken" is too general. You need to specify the exact issue, like "The dairy freezer stopped working this morning, which made my ice cream melt."
Using "you owe me money" sounds aggressive. A more polite way is "I’d appreciate it if you could offer some compensation for the trouble."
Forgetting to check your other purchases might mean you’re missing out on getting refunds for other damaged goods.
life_supermarket_freezer_08.ai: Alex是超市客服人员，他会说经理已经联系了维修师傅，还会说可以给你全额退款，另外赠送一张20元的超市代金券。
life_supermarket_freezer_08.task: 向超市客服说明商品变质的情况，协商退款和合理补偿。

tgt: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to Shinjuku Gyoen? I'm a bit lost here.
My map is wet and I can't read it clearly, can you show me the way on your phone?
Thank you so much for your help, I really appreciate it.

tgt: Per IFRS 16, leases of equipment with a term longer than 12 months and a total value above the group’s threshold must be classified as finance leases.
The 12-month term and 870,000 EUR total value of the vehicle leases meet the criteria for finance lease classification under IFRS 16.
Can we coordinate a call with the Norwegian subsidiary’s finance team to walk through the IFRS 16 requirements for lease classification?
traps: "You’re wrong" is confrontational and will shut down communication; use "Based on our review of IFRS 16 and the lease terms, this classification may need to be adjusted to align with global standards" to present the requirement as a compliance matter.

"The tax law says different" conflates tax and accounting standards; use "While local tax regulations may offer different treatment, IFRS 16 requires us to classify the leases based on the economic substance of the agreement" to clarify the distinction.

Saying "we don’t do it that way" is unprofessional; use "The group’s audit policy requires all subsidiaries to comply with IFRS 16 lease classification standards" to reference the consistent group requirements.
aud_grp_fy25_norway_lease_audit.ai: Alex是挪威组件审计的高级经理，他的立场是当地车辆租赁市场通常将此类交易归类为经营租赁，且子公司认为该类租赁符合当地税法的优惠政策，不愿调整报表分类。
aud_grp_fy25_norway_lease_audit.task: 说服挪威组件审计团队和当地子公司，按IFRS 16准则将该类租赁重新分类为融资租赁并调整合并报表数据。

tgt: Oh my gosh, I completely forgot this was your anniversary! I am so sorry.
Let me grab a drink from the bar to toast to you both, happy 5 years together.
I’ll make it up to you next week, I’ll take you both out for a fancy dinner to celebrate properly.
traps: 说"I forgot"太敷衍，应该用"I totally blanked on that"来表达自己的疏忽
直接纠正主人"This is not our anniversary"，完全否定对方的纪念日，会让她非常生气
用中式英语"Happy birthday"代替结婚纪念日祝福，会显得非常不贴心
soc_guest_forgot_anniversary.ai: Alex是Luna，她正和丈夫一起布置餐桌，墙上贴着他们的结婚照片，她随口问你有没有记得这次聚会的特别意义。
soc_guest_forgot_anniversary.task: 快速圆场，真诚道歉并补上迟到的祝福，不要让表姐觉得你不重视她的重要日子。

tgt: Could you share the status of the three pending cross-border fund compliance reviews we’ve been working on?
I’ll reach out to your team to schedule a handover call with your replacement before your departure.
Please provide a summary of the key documentation we need to submit for the ongoing reviews.
traps: 使用"You have to help us finish the work"这种命令式表达，地道表达应该是"We’d appreciate your support in wrapping up the pending reviews and introducing us to your replacement"。
混淆"contact person"和"contact guy"的语域，在专业商务场景中应使用"designated liaison"或"primary contact"，避免使用过于口语化的表达。
直译"离职"为"you leave"，地道的商务表达应该是"your upcoming departure"或"your planned last day"。
wk_exit_bank_liaison_leave.ai: 汤姆·王是银行的合规对接人，立场是希望完成手头的对接工作后正常离职，诉求是希望双方尽快确认新的对接人，确保合规审查流程不中断。
wk_exit_bank_liaison_leave.task: 和汤姆确认当前未完成的合规审查事项，协调渣打银行安排新的对接人，同步部门内部的对接流程。

tgt: I’ve been obsessed with this sci-fi podcast called *The Penumbra Podcast* lately, it mixes detective stories with space adventures, it’s so unique.
Each episode has a full cast of voice actors, so it feels like listening to a mini radio drama instead of just a host talking.
I’ve been listening to it during all my flights this month, it makes the time go by so much faster.
traps: A typical mistake is saying 'I listen this podcast' which is wrong, the correct collocation is 'listen to a podcast'.
Many Chinese speakers translate '科幻播客' directly as 'science fiction talk show' which is not accurate, the correct term is 'sci-fi podcast' for casual use.
People often use too formal language like 'I highly recommend' with a flight attendant in a casual chat, you can use more relaxed phrases like 'I’ve been obsessed with' to sound natural.
talk_book_flight_attendant.ai: 空乘是20多岁的日本女生，英语流利，看起来喜欢科幻题材的内容，愿意跟你闲聊几句。
talk_book_flight_attendant.task: 用英语跟空乘聊你正在听的科幻播客，分享一下你的看法。

tgt: I only have one key to my apartment, could I get an extra pair made?
How much does it cost to have a spare key made?
How far in advance do I need to book the key duplication service?
traps: 误用"I want a spare key"，语气过于直接，地道说法应该用"Could I request an extra key for my apartment?"，更礼貌且符合日常沟通的语气
误用"How much is it?"，不够具体，地道说法应该是"How much do you charge for key duplication?"，明确指出服务内容避免误解
误用"I need it right now"，过于强硬，地道说法应该用"Could you let me know the timeline for this?"，更温和地询问办理时间
life_rent_key_request.ai: Alex是你的房东，他会说配钥匙需要收取20美元的工本费，并且需要你提前一周预约时间。
life_rent_key_request.task: 向房东申请多配一把房门钥匙，了解费用和办理流程

tgt: We have identified an oversight in the half-year report disclosure of three related party fund transactions with a total value of 6.5 million HKD.
The oversight occurred due to a lack of standardized tracking procedures for related party transactions across regional offices.
We have updated our related party disclosure checklist and will conduct a full review of all related party transactions before the FY26 annual report filing.
traps: 使用"we forgot to report"过于直白且带有负面色彩，正式汇报中应使用"we have identified an oversight in the half-year report disclosure"，更客观地描述失误。
直译"关联方资金往来"为"related party money transfer"，地道的专业表达应为"related party fund transactions"，符合财务合规汇报的专业术语规范。
使用"we will remember next time"过于随意，正式汇报中应使用"we have updated our related party disclosure checklist and will conduct a full review before the annual report filing"，体现专业的整改措施。
aud_ac_report_related_party_disclosure.ai: Alex是委员会的财务专家委员，他先询问遗漏的具体环节和责任人，希望了解整改的落地情况。
aud_ac_report_related_party_disclosure.task: 向委员会说明关联方资金往来遗漏的原因，提交补充披露的方案，更新后续的关联方披露流程。

tgt: I’ve been trying to get into my room for 15 minutes and the key card just won’t work. I’m really tired after a long day of sightseeing, so this is a bit frustrating.
I appreciate the offer to upgrade to a suite, that would be really helpful. Would it be possible to get a free breakfast voucher for tomorrow morning as a small compensation?
I hope the lock issue can be fixed properly so this doesn’t happen to other guests later.
traps: Don’t say "my door is broken". The problem is the key card/lock system, you should say "the key card won’t work for my room" or "the door lock isn’t responding".
Don’t say "I wait for you a long time". Use "I’ve been waiting for 15 minutes" to show how long the delay has been.
Don’t say "give me free breakfast". Polite way to ask is "would it be possible to get a free breakfast voucher" instead of a direct demand.
talk_complain_hotel_locked_room.ai: Alex是酒店夜班前台，他连连道歉说今天客房系统出了小故障，已经联系了锁匠，最快也要半小时才能到，提出可以给你升级到套房暂时休息。
talk_complain_hotel_locked_room.task: 礼貌地表达自己的困扰，说明自己逛了一天很累想早点休息，接受升级套房的提议，同时希望酒店能补偿一晚的早餐券。

tgt: Hi, I’m the resident from Building 11. I wanted to mention that your golden retriever was barking nonstop all night yesterday.
It was really loud and even scared my cat into hiding under the sofa.
Could you please keep your dog indoors when you go out next time?
traps: 直接说“Your dog is annoying”，语气太冲，地道的表达应该用“I was disturbed by your dog’s barking all night”。
直译“整夜吠叫”说成“bark all night”，缺少副词，地道的说法是“was barking nonstop all night”。
用“You must control your dog”命令式语气，不礼貌，应该用委婉的请求“Would you mind keeping your dog indoors when you’re out?”
soc_nb_dog_barking_all_night.ai: Alex是隔壁12栋的业主张女士，她昨晚临时出门倒垃圾没把狗关在家里，回来发现狗一直在叫，现在很不好意思，愿意配合解决问题。
soc_nb_dog_barking_all_night.task: 说明狗狗整夜吠叫影响自己休息的情况，希望对方以后出门时把狗关在室内。

tgt: No worries, let’s just restart the prep and take it slower this time.
I’ll lead the way this time, so you can focus on following the route.
We’ve got plenty of time to get this done right, let’s try again.
traps: 说"you messed up everything"，会让对方感到自责，地道说法应该是"that was a little unexpected, let’s fix it"
直接退出任务队伍，会让其他队友感到孤立，地道的表达应该是"let’s just restart the mission together"
使用"I told you so"这种事后指责的表达，会破坏团队信任，地道的表达应该是"let’s be more careful next time"
hob_video_gta_online_heist_fail.ai: Noah是住在纽约的美国玩家，他刚才在看导航没注意路况，现在很懊恼，想道歉并提议重新开一局任务。
hob_video_gta_online_heist_fail.task: 快速重新开启任务，调整路线避免再次失误，同时不让团队士气低落。

tgt: The sun is shining perfectly today, isn’t it?
The views of the Matterhorn are so clear with this clear weather.
Is the snow condition usually this good this time of year?
traps: 说“The sun is very bright”，搭配生硬，地道说法应该用“The sun is shining beautifully”或者“It’s a perfect ski day”
用“snow very good”描述雪况，地道搭配是“great snow conditions”或者“powdery snow”
直接问“how is snow here”，不地道，地道说法应该用“How’s the snow quality today?”或者“Is the snow good for skiing?”
talk_weather_ski_resort_sun.ai: Alex是加拿大来的滑雪者，他正看着窗外的马特洪峰，感叹今天的好天气。
talk_weather_ski_resort_sun.task: 和滑雪者闲聊滑雪场的天气，问问他这个季节的雪况怎么样

tgt: I saw your open mic poster and I'd like to sign up for this Saturday's show.
I only need a basic microphone and a small amplifier for my acoustic guitar performance.
Can you tell me the exact start time and how long each performer gets to play?
traps: 说"I want to sing here"，过于随意且没有说明具体活动，地道说法应该是"I'd like to sign up for your open mic night"。
直接说"I have many songs"，没有具体说明曲目类型，地道说法应该补充"I plan to play two original folk songs"。
用"Give me a microphone"，语气过于命令式，地道的礼貌请求应该是"Could I use the house microphone and amplifier for my performance?"
hob_music_cafe_open_mic.ai: Alex是这家咖啡馆的店长，他负责开放麦活动的报名和现场安排，他需要确认你表演的曲目类型和所需的伴奏设备。
hob_music_cafe_open_mic.task: 跟店长确认报名信息，了解现场设备情况，顺利完成开放麦的报名。

tgt: I’m so sorry I missed the ceremony—this flight delay was totally out of my control!
I brought a little wedding gift for you two, I hope it’s not too late!
Congratulations again, I can’t wait to hear all about your special day over dinner tonight.
traps: 直接说"I missed your wedding"，语气太沉重，地道表达应该是"I’m so gutted I missed the ceremony"或者"I’m really sorry I arrived late to the wedding"。
用"It’s your fault"指责航班延误，不符合社交礼仪，地道说法是"This delay was completely out of my hands"来客观说明情况。
生硬要求补请吃饭说成"We must eat dinner"，地道表达应该是"Let’s grab dinner tonight so I can hear all about the wedding"来自然邀约。
soc_congrats_wedding_airport.ai: Alex是你的大学室友，他刚结束婚礼赶来机场接你，语气带着失望但又很开心见到你。
soc_congrats_wedding_airport.task: 你需要向室友道歉，同时表达对他们新婚的祝福。

tgt: Thank you so much for walking my corgi every day for the past month.
This pet grooming kit is a small thank you for your help.
I really appreciate you taking such good care of my dog.
traps: 说"I busy work, thank you" 中式直译且语法错误，正确的表达应该是"I've been so busy with work and I really appreciate your help"。
说"I give you this gift" 中式直译，地道的表达应该是"I have this gift for you"。
说"You walk my dog, thank you" 过于生硬，地道的表达应该是"Thank you so much for walking my dog every day"。
life_gift_dog_walker.ai: Alex是这位遛狗师，他会说帮助狗狗很开心，还会问你的柯基犬是不是很喜欢散步。
life_gift_dog_walker.task: 向遛狗师说明自己的感谢，并成功送出宠物美容礼盒。

tgt: We're unable to provide internal process optimization services for our audit clients under HKSA independence standards.
Our firm's independence rules prevent us from developing or recommending internal controls for the companies we audit.
I appreciate your request, but we can't support this work to maintain our audit objectivity.
traps: 使用"you can't help"这种命令式语气，不符合沟通礼仪，应该用"we're unable to"来表达合规限制，体现专业性。
把"内部流程优化"直译成"internal process optimize"语法错误，地道的表达是"internal process optimization services"。
用"a little time"来轻描淡写占用的时间，不符合专业场景，应该明确说明该服务不在审计团队的服务范围内，而非强调时间问题。
aud_indep_internal_audit_staff.ai: 我是内部审计主管李先生，我们部门最近人手不够，没法及时完成费用报销流程的梳理，你们审计组对公司的财务流程很熟悉，能不能帮忙做个初步的流程优化建议？不会占用你们太多审计时间的。
aud_indep_internal_audit_staff.task: 清晰说明审计团队不能提供内部流程优化服务，解释独立性约束的原因，友好收尾。

tgt: What extra toppings are included in the standard price?
Can I add banana and granola without extra charge?
How much would it cost to add honey on top?
traps: 直接说“I want more toppings”，表达不够具体，地道表达应该用“What extra toppings can I add?”
用“free”代替“included in the price”，搭配不够地道，地道表达应该用“included in the standard price”
直接在配料台乱拿配料，会耽误后面的客人，应该先询问店员再选择
talk_food_rio_de_janeiro_acai_bowl.ai: Alex是acai碗店的店员，20多岁，正在快速地给客人装碗，他只会简单的英语，说话很快，有点赶时间。
talk_food_rio_de_janeiro_acai_bowl.task: 用英语礼貌地询问店员可以加哪些配料，以及是否额外收费，然后选择自己喜欢的配料。

tgt: I pulled my hamstring during a downward dog pose earlier this week.
I’ve been using a heating pad and taking gentle walks to help with the recovery.
You should probably hold off on deep stretches until the soreness goes away fully.
traps: 把“腘绳肌拉伤”直译成“hamstring muscle pull”，虽然语法正确，但日常口语中更常用“I pulled my hamstring”来简洁表达。
用“very sore”来形容疼痛程度，地道的表达可以是“aches a lot”或者“has a dull ache”，更符合描述肌肉酸痛的习惯。
错误使用“do yoga”来表达练习瑜伽，标准的日常搭配应该是“practice yoga”或者“do a yoga flow”。
talk_health_neighbor_yoga_injury.ai: Tom是50岁的退休中学老师，平时喜欢在家做瑜伽，上周自学了新月式动作后，感觉大腿后侧一直酸痛，想问问你是不是运动拉伤了。
talk_health_neighbor_yoga_injury.task: 和Tom分享自己拉伤后的恢复办法，提醒他新手不要盲目跟练网上的教程，最后建议他如果疼痛持续就去看物理治疗师。

tgt: You fixed my brakes so quickly, I was worried I wouldn’t be able to finish my trip today, thank you so much.
This craft beer is from the brewery down the road, I picked it up specifically for you as a thank you.
Please don’t feel like you have to refuse, I really appreciate all the extra work you did.
traps: 把"公路车"直译成"road bike"虽然没错，但更地道的说法是"racing bike"或者"drop-bar bike"
用"thank you for fixing my bike"太笼统，没有具体提到检修刹车和调整车座的细节
说"I pay you extra"会让对方觉得你在暗示他收费过高，地道的说法应该用"it’s really kind of you to do this for free"来肯定他的免费服务
soc_thanks_bike_shop_tech.ai: Alex是自行车店技师马克，他会说检修刹车是他的本职工作，不需要额外感谢，还会说调整车座是免费的常规服务。
soc_thanks_bike_shop_tech.task: 解释他的加急帮助让你能按时完成骑行计划，让他收下啤酒

tgt: Hello, I’m so sorry I’m running 32 minutes late for checkout. I was taking photos on the rooftop terrace and lost track of time.
I heard you can extend the checkout time to 12:00, is that still available for me?
I’ll be down with my luggage in 5 minutes, thank you for your patience.
traps: I take photos so I late. 中式英语直译且语法错误，正确说法是I was taking photos on the rooftop and missed the checkout time.
I want delay checkout. 搭配不地道，地道表达是I’d like to request a late checkout or can I extend my checkout time?
You help me pack. 语气太直接，礼貌的说法应该是Could you please help me with my luggage?
soc_late_hotel_checkout.ai: Alex是酒店的前台接待员，正站在前台等候你过来办理退房，他的诉求是告知你可以延迟到12:00退房，询问你是否需要协助打包行李。
soc_late_hotel_checkout.task: 向前台诚恳道歉，解释迟到原因，确认可以延迟到12:00退房，办理退房手续。

tgt: Can I confirm the booking for spot number 2 from October 12th to 14th?
What's the allowed fishing time at this campsite?
Do I need to bring my own fishing license for the park?
traps: I need a place to fish near river. 缺少冠词，正确的是I need a spot to fish near the river。
You can rent the spot to me? 搭配错误，预订钓位应该用book或者reserve，rent一般指长期租赁场地，短期露营钓位用book更地道。
I pay all money now. 中式直译，地道说法应该是I'll pay the full amount in advance right now。
hob_fish_campsite_reserve.ai: Alex是露营地前台服务员，态度友好，会解释营地的规定，比如钓位不能转租，晚上10点后不能大声喧哗影响其他露营者。
hob_fish_campsite_reserve.task: 确认2号钓位的预订信息，并且了解营地允许的钓鱼时段。

tgt: No problem at all, come in and take what you need.
The tire jack and air pump are in the garage storage cabinet by the front door.
Let me show you where they are if you can't find them right away.
traps: Yes, you can borrow my tool. 指代模糊，工具是复数，应该用you can borrow my tools或者the tire jack and air pump.
I have many tools here. 中式表达，地道口语应该用Sure, go ahead and take what you need.
You take it easy. 搭配错误，安慰别人应该用don't worry或者take your time.
talk_car_neighbor_borrow_tool.ai: Alex是你的隔壁邻居，他态度友好，会先道歉打扰你，然后说明自己的汽车爆胎需要工具，希望能借用你的千斤顶和充气泵。
talk_car_neighbor_borrow_tool.task: 友好回应邻居的借工具请求，告知工具存放位置并协助邻居更换轮胎。

tgt: Excuse me, are you planning to go surfing today? I’ve been checking the tides too.
The waves here are perfect for beginners this morning, I can show you my favorite spot if you want.
I know a great local warung nearby, would you want to grab dinner with me later?
traps: 说“Surfing is very fun”中式直译，地道说法应该是“I’ve been having such a great time surfing here”或者“The waves here are so fun to ride”。
用“Your surfboard is beautiful”太笼统，应该说“I love your surfboard— what brand is it?”来开启更自然的对话。
直接说“Let’s eat together”太生硬，应该先确认对方的行程再提议比如“Would you be interested in checking out this local warung I found nearby for dinner?”
life_party_beach_greet.ai: Alex是来巴厘岛学冲浪的加拿大游客，刚到海滩正纠结今天适不适合冲浪，对你的搭话很欢迎。
life_party_beach_greet.task: 和对方聊起冲浪的注意事项，提议一起去附近的餐厅吃晚饭。

tgt: I stayed at the Airbnb apartment in Paris from October 5th to 7th, and the host didn't provide the free breakfast and parking service as promised in the booking.
I tried to contact the host but got no response, could you please help me resolve this issue?
I hope the platform can assist me in getting a partial refund or appropriate compensation for this inconvenience.
traps: 说"The host is bad"属于主观评价，不符合投诉的正式语境，应该客观陈述事实"The host didn't provide the promised free breakfast and parking service"。

tgt: I have a confirmation code for my payment on Tuesday morning.

traps: 报错词用 "I paid the money already"。这听起来像是在无理取闹，地道说法是 "My payment was successfully processed" 或 "The charge was already deducted from my account"。

把申诉说成 "I want to protest"。"Protest" 常指街头抗议或强烈反对，在法律/行政语境下，地道说法是 "I would like to file an appeal against this penalty notice"。

tgt: I saw 'BYOB' on your invite, what does that mean?

traps: 用 'What is BYOB?' 这种过于直白质问的语气，听起来像是在审讯。用 'I'm not familiar with the term BYOB...' 更委婉、更有礼貌。
误以为对方请客就不用带东西。BYOB 代表 'Bring Your Own Beer/Beverage'，如果说 'I will bring nothing' 会被认为不懂社交礼节。
混淆 'beer' 和 'beers'。在口语里，'bring some beers' 特指几罐/几瓶啤酒，比抽象的 'bring beer' 听起来更具体、更生活化。
talk_cul_byob_barbecue.ai: 邻居 Alex，性格随和，正在筹备烧烤，很乐意向你解释这个当地派对文化，并给你一些带饮料的建议。

说 "I will delete this sentence to give you face."——give face 是中文直译，英语没这个说法，听着像做人情交换。说 "I'm happy to take it out" 或 "I can reword it so it's less pointed."

别说 “I already have a boyfriend/girlfriend, sorry.” 当挡箭牌 —— 姑且不论真假，英语里把拒绝挂在第三个人身上会显得你自己没立场。直接的 “I'm not interested in dating right now” 更干净也更被尊重。

tgt: Fair enough, plenty of people are like that — but I've been watching Bayern since Robben and Ribéry.

talk_sport_beer_hall.task: 不生气也不认怂，用具体的东西证明你是认真看球的，最后把气氛拉回到一起看这剩下的 25 分钟。

tgt: In a stock deal, the target's assets get written up to fair value for accounting purposes, but the tax basis often isn't stepped up, so you lose the extra depreciation and amortization tax shields.
That creates a book-tax difference where future taxable income will be higher than book income, so the buyer records a deferred tax liability.
If it were an asset deal or a 338(h)(10) election, you'd get the tax basis step-up and might not see a large DTL.
traps: 错句："The book value of the assets is increased, but the tax base is not increased, causing a temporary difference." 问题：用词重复、句式单调；且“tax base”是宽泛税基概念，资产计税基础应说“tax basis”；“increased”不如“written up”或“stepped up”符合投行语境。地道说法："The assets get written up for book purposes, but the tax basis isn't stepped up, creating a temporary difference."

错句："The buyer cannot enjoy the tax shield from the higher depreciation and amortization." 问题：“enjoy”在此语境过于随意，且“tax shield from”搭配不自然；投行口语中常用“get the benefit of”或“lose the additional tax shields”。地道说法："The buyer loses the additional depreciation and amortization tax shields."

错句："The tax base is not adjusted up, so we have a DTL." 问题：“tax base”用错，资产计税基础应说“tax basis”；“adjusted up”不符合术语习惯，应说“stepped up”；结尾“we have a DTL”较生硬。地道说法："The tax basis isn't stepped up, so a DTL is created."
itv_mna_dtl_stock_deal_tax_basis.ai: 你演面试官VP，熟悉并购会计和税务结构，会顺着你的回答追问stock deal与asset deal的差异、以及对goodwill的影响，但不会故意刁难。
itv_mna_dtl_stock_deal_tax_basis.task: 用最地道的英文，在90秒内把PPA重估、tax basis未step-up、缺税盾导致DTL这条逻辑说清，并能接住一个关于交易结构的追问。

把"football"说成"soccer"，在新西兰地区football特指橄榄球，soccer才是英式足球，容易造成误解。
直接站起来走开不沟通，应该和旁边的观众交流或者礼貌提醒家长，解决问题。
talk_sport_zoo_football.ai: Alex是坐在你旁边的本地观众，他也被小男孩打扰了，他会轻轻跟你吐槽一下这个情况。
talk_sport_zoo_football.task: 和旁边的观众自然交流，或者礼貌提醒小男孩的妈妈看管好孩子。

tgt: The kiosk ran out of paper while printing my bag tags.
Could you help me reprint the tags for my checked luggage?
Here is my boarding pass that just came out.
traps: 直译腔："The machine has no paper." 语法虽然没错，但最地道的说法是使用短语 "run out of"，即 "The kiosk ran out of paper"。
表达模糊：把行李条说成 "baggage paper" 或 "luggage sticker"。机场的官方说法是 "bag tag" 或 "luggage tag"，重打是 "reprint the tags"。
语气命令："Print my tags here." 显得没有礼貌。应该用询问和请求的语气："Could you help me print the tags, please?"
life_air_kiosk_no_paper.ai: 机场自助值机区的工作人员，态度积极，会检查你的登机牌，并在主柜台帮你重新补打行李条。
life_air_kiosk_no_paper.task: 解释机器没纸了，出示登机牌，请求对方帮你重新打印行李条以完成行李托运。

tgt: My wallet was stolen while I was doing my laundry here about 10 minutes ago.
Could you please let me check the security camera footage?
Can you call the local police for me as well?
traps: 说"someone took my wallet"太模糊，应该直接说"I left my wallet on the bench and it's gone now"
用"I am very panic"语法错误，正确的是"I'm really panicked"或者"I'm so upset"
直接要求"call police"太生硬，应该用"Could you call the police for me?"更礼貌
soc_bad_laundromat_stolen_wallet.ai: Alex是洗衣店的夜班店员，他正在整理收银台，看到你慌张地过来后停下手中的工作准备询问。
soc_bad_laundromat_stolen_wallet.task: 向店员说明情况并请求调取监控和联系警方

tgt: Whoops, my bad! I thought you were my classmate Liam who has the same red backpack.
I was just trying to ask about the next lecture room, sorry for the mix-up.
Do you happen to know where the marketing 101 class is held today?
traps: 直接说"You are not my classmate"，会让对方感到尴尬，应该先道歉再解释；
用"I see your backpack so I called you"，逻辑不够自然，应该补充说明对方和朋友的相似点；
用错误的介词"ask to you"，正确应该是"ask you"或者"ask someone about something"
soc_name_campus_classmate_mixup.ai: Alex是其他专业的学生，他不是Liam，此刻正抬起头看你，手里拿着自己的课程表。
soc_name_campus_classmate_mixup.task: 道歉并解释误会，询问自己的下一节课教室

tgt: The view over the Pudong skyline is amazing at night, have you been to this rooftop before?
It’s such a great opportunity to catch up with industry peers, how’s your night been going?
Quick check on the follow-up interview requests we sent over last week, would your team be available next week?
traps: 用“酒会”直译“wine party”，正式商务酒会的地道表达应该是“industry networking cocktail event”
用“我有一些请求”直译“I have some requests”，不符合酒会轻松的语境，地道说法应该用“quick check on the interview requests”
直接拿着酒杯凑过去，没有先和对方打招呼，显得过于冒失
wk_small_shanghai_party.ai: Alex扮演跨境支付公司亚太区合规总监Chris，他刚结束和参会嘉宾的沟通，想先喝点气泡水放松一下，再和你确认合规尽调的后续访谈安排。
wk_small_shanghai_party.task: 自然开启酒会场景的寒暄，回应对方的状态，确认访谈安排

tgt: I’m really sorry for ruining your bike tire, that was totally my fault.
Would it be okay if I pay for a new tire or help you get it fixed right now?
I can also cover the cost of a taxi for you to get to your destination if you need it.
traps: Saying "It’s not a big deal" minimizes the other person’s trouble, which comes off as insensitive in English, you should take responsibility fully instead of downplaying the accident.
Translating "扎破" directly to "punctured" is correct but some Chinese learners might say "broke" which is less accurate for tire damage.
Using "you" too many times sounds accusatory, native speakers often use "your" to focus on the situation rather than blaming the other person.
life_acc_bike_tire_puncture.ai: Alex是推婴儿车的路人，他的折叠自行车胎是刚换的新品，现在没法正常使用，正有点着急地跟你说明情况。
life_acc_bike_tire_puncture.task: 主动道歉并协商赔偿或帮忙解决对方的出行问题。

tgt: The security tag was left on the bag, and I have an event to attend shortly.
I can't wait for half an hour as my event starts at 7 PM.
Could you please prioritize this since it was an oversight by your staff?
traps: 把“防盗扣”说成 "the lock"。防盗扣的标准英文是 "security tag"，如果是带墨水的则叫 "ink tag"。
粗暴地催促 "I have no time to wait, do it now."。这会激化矛盾，地道得体的说法是 "I'm on a very tight schedule, is there any way to speed this up?"。
警告对方赔偿说成 "If the ink leaks, you must pay me."。听起来像威胁，地道表达是 "If the bag gets damaged during removal, I expect a replacement or full compensation."。
life_shop_security_tag.ai: 店员。向你道歉，但表示“今天店里人手不足，需要去仓库拿专门的解锁器，可能要让你等半小时以上”。
life_shop_security_tag.task: 强调你晚上有紧急活动，你无法等待半小时，要求他们立刻优先插队为你处理，并声明如果是店员操作失误导致皮包损坏，对方必须承担责任。

tgt: I was wondering if I could possibly borrow your portable camp stove for a day.
Just to be double sure, do I need to bring my own gas canisters or do you have spares?
I will definitely return it to you first thing Monday morning without fail.
traps: 使用 'I want to borrow your stove' 显得过于生硬直接，地道说法应用 'I was wondering if I could borrow...'。
询问气罐时说 'Do you have gas?' 容易产生误解，应具体说 'gas canisters' 或 'fuel tanks'。
承诺归还时用 'I will give you back' 搭配不够自然，应使用 'return it to you'。
soc_borrow_camping_stove.ai: Alex 是你的邻居，手里正好有一台双头野营炉。他愿意借给你，但提醒你这个炉子点火器有点老化，需要用打火机辅助，并想确认你周一早上能否归还，因为他自己周二要用。
soc_borrow_camping_stove.task: 成功借到露营炉，确认使用注意事项，并承诺周一准时归还。

tgt: To be honest, this is a bit shorter than what I had in mind.
I only wanted to trim about an inch, but it looks like quite a bit more was taken off.
Is there any way we can style the front to make it look a bit softer?
traps: 脱口而出 "You ruined my hair!"。这过于情绪化，容易让对方产生防备心理。地道、委婉的表达应是 "It's a bit shorter than I expected."。
说 "Why did you cut so much?"。带有强烈的指责语气，听起来像在吵架。地道的反馈可以用 "I think we had a slight misunderstanding about the length."。
直译 "I don't like this hair"。这听起来像小孩子抱怨，不够成熟体面。地道说法是 "I'm not entirely comfortable with this length."
soc_conflict_haircut_too_short.ai: Alex 扮演理发师。他态度很好，解释说是因为你发尾有些分叉所以多剪了一些，但他非常愿意在接下来的造型和刘海处理上进行微调，让你看起来更满意。
soc_conflict_haircut_too_short.task: 委婉但明确地指出剪得比预想的要短，并与理发师商量怎么挽救或调整造型。

tgt: We only go skiing once a year; it doesn't make sense to own everything.
Storing all that bulky gear in our apartment will be a nightmare.
Why don't we just invest in good boots first and rent the skis?
traps: 说 'The cloth is expensive'。滑雪服应该叫 'ski gear' 或 'ski suit'，而不是普通的 'clothes'。
说 'Our house is small'。在谈论存放物品时，用 'We're short on storage space' 更地道。
说 'It is not worth it'。这听起来有点否定对方的爱好，用 'I'm not sure we'll get enough use out of it' 更好。
soc_partner_ski_gear.ai: Alex。立场是：租来的鞋子不舒服且有味道，而且拥有自己的装备会更有动力去练习。他已经选好了款式，正准备下单。
soc_partner_ski_gear.task: 劝阻 Alex 的冲动消费，建议如果真的要买，可以先买贴身的头盔和雪鞋，板子还是用租的。

tgt: I just signed for your package, would you like me to keep it inside my place until you're back?
I'm worried about leaving it in the hallway, so feel free to pick it up whenever you're ready.
Should I just leave it by your front door, or would you prefer me to hold onto it for you?
traps: 使用 'Do you want to put it in my home?' 听起来像是在命令对方，更地道应使用 'Would you like me to...'。
使用 'I can help you to keep it'，英语中 'help' 后面接宾语不需要加 'to'，直接说 'help you keep it'。
误用 'safely'，说成 'Is it safe to put in my home?' 应直接问 'Would it be safer if I kept it for you?'。
life_nb_holiday_delivery.ai: Alex是隔壁的住户，他很感激你帮他保管包裹，并告诉你他大概会在晚上7点回来取。
life_nb_holiday_delivery.task: 与邻居确认包裹的安全存放位置。

tgt: I almost forgot what blue sky looks like after staring at gray clouds for a straight week.
Are locals really this obsessed with outdoor activities the moment the sun peeks out?
I should probably cancel my indoor plans and go rent a kayak on the lake.
traps: 说成 'I forgot the sky is blue.' 语义不精准，表达“几乎忘了蓝天长什么样”地道说法是 'I almost forgot what blue sky looks like.'。
说 'Do people like outdoor activities when it is sunny?' 语气过于平淡，地道表达会用 'Are locals really this obsessed with outdoor activities?'。
说 'I will not stay inside today.' 不够生动，地道表达会用 'I should probably cancel my indoor plans and go rent a kayak.'。
talk_weather_seattle_sunshine.ai: Alex 扮演一位常住西雅图的本地居民。她兴奋地跟你谈论这难得的阳光，并开玩笑说西雅图人只要见到太阳就会立刻抛弃手头所有工作往户外跑。
talk_weather_seattle_sunshine.task: 附和西雅图的阴雨天气，并分享你刚搬来或刚到这里时对这种天气转变的不适应。

tgt: It actually uses much less water than hand-washing.
The high temperature can sterilize the dishes, which is healthier.
Why don't we try it together tonight just to see?
traps: 把‘洗碗机’说成 "wash bowl machine"。这是典型的中式直译，正确的英文单词是唯一的 "dishwasher"。
直译‘费水费电’为 "it wastes water and electric"。这里 "electric" 是形容词，应该用名词 "electricity"，或者更地道地表达为 "it runs up the utility bills"（增加水电费账单）。
直译‘消灭病毒/细菌’为 "kill the virus"。在日常洗碗和健康语境下，‘高温消毒’最地道的词是 "sterilize the dishes" 或 "sanitize the plates"，用 "kill virus" 听起来太像医学实验室里的操作。
soc_elder_dishwasher.ai: 母亲。节俭持家，觉得用手刷一下很快，不相信机器比手洗干净，而且心疼水电费。
soc_elder_dishwasher.task: 劝说母亲尝试使用洗碗机，向她解释机器其实更省水，且能高温杀菌。

tgt: I find that the Rule of Thirds gives this particular piece a sense of balance.
You mentioned it's a bit 'cliché'—I'd love to hear how you'd frame it differently.
Photography is subjective, but I think classic rules still serve a purpose.
traps: 不要说 "I like it, you are wrong"。艺术讨论要用 "I see your point, however..."。
避免把 "composition" 说成 "layout"。照片构图专指 "composition"。
别说 "Your idea is weird"。用地道的 "That's an unconventional take on it"。
hob_photo_paris_critique.ai: Alex 是个艺术评论家，说话比较毒舌，他认为你的审美还停留在摄影教材的第一页。
hob_photo_paris_critique.task: 捍卫你的审美观点，同时保持开放态度讨论为什么“经典构图”依然有其生命力，并请教他认为更有趣的构图方式。

tgt: I have a solo performance in less than four hours and my voice is completely gone.
I understand prescription limits, but is there any high-strength OTC throat spray available?
What fast-acting remedy do you recommend for sudden vocal strain?
traps: 直译“我的嗓子哑了/没声音了”为 'my throat is dead/no voice'，地道表达是 'my voice is gone' 或 'I've lost my voice'。
把“非处方药”说成 'no-recipe medicine'，地道表达是 'OTC (over-the-counter) medication'。
表示“见效快的药物”说成 'fast-effect medicine'，地道搭配是 'fast-acting remedy' 或 'quick-relief spray'。
hob_sing_pharmacy_vocal_emergency.ai: Alex 是药房执业药剂师，遵循严格的药品管制法律，拒绝无处方销售处方药，但愿意推荐非处方（OTC）替代方案。
hob_sing_pharmacy_vocal_emergency.task: 说明今晚表演的紧急程度，询问是否有即效性强的非处方润喉喷雾、含片或应急声带护理方案。

tgt: The bottom container is clearly moldy, which is unacceptable for a fresh product.
I'd like to get a refund just for the damaged container, as I've already opened the others.
Since I can't be sure about the quality of the rest, I’d prefer a refund for this specific item.
traps: 说 'These berries are bad' 容易被误解为口味不好。应说 'This container is spoiled' 或 'It has mold on it'。
说 'You sold me broken food' 太像指责。应说 'I noticed this item was already spoiled when I opened the bag'。
说 'Give me my money' 带有命令口吻。建议使用 'Would it be possible to get a refund for this item?'
life_shop_fruit_mold.ai: 收银主管，查看后认为蓝莓是易腐品，只能帮你换一盒，不给退钱。
life_shop_fruit_mold.task: 坚持只买了一盒，其余两盒没拆封不想留下，要求退掉坏的那盒的钱。

tgt: It's highly entertaining and surprisingly deep.
It's a great way to pass the time on a long flight.
You'll definitely get a good laugh out of it.
traps: 不要用中式英语 "I suggest you to look at this"，"suggest" 后面不能接 "sb. to do"，应该说 "I highly recommend checking this out" 或是 "You should definitely watch it"。
表达“解压/放松”时，不要说 "relax your pressure"（语法错误），地道的说法是 "it's great for unwinding" 或者 "it's a great stress-reliever"。
不要把“好玩的梗”翻译成 "funny jokes"（显得很老套），可以用 "witty humor"（机智的幽默）或 "clever references"。
talk_movie_flight_neighbor.ai: Sarah，一位略显疲惫的邻座乘客。她想在漫长的飞行中看点轻松幽默又不失深度的东西，正在纠结这部电影是否适合长途飞行。
talk_movie_flight_neighbor.task: 告诉她这部电影非常解压，有很多好玩的梗，同时又有一些引发思考的地方，非常适合在长途飞行中看。

tgt: Thanks for mentioning the deal, but my teeth are actually quite sensitive.
I'm really just here for the routine cleaning today, so I'll stick to that.
I also have an appointment right after this, so I need to head out as soon as I pay.
traps: 直译“My teeth fear cold”表示牙齿敏感；地道表达必须使用专用形容词，如“My teeth are sensitive”或“I have sensitive teeth”。
使用“I don't need whitening”（我不需要美白），语气听起来冷淡攻击性强；地道拒绝可以用“I'm good with just the cleaning today”或“Whitening isn't really a priority for me”。
把“Just charge me for cleaning”误说成“Give me bill of wash teeth”，动词与名词搭配均不符合英语习惯；地道表达为“I'm ready to settle the bill for the cleaning.”
soc_decline_teeth_whitening.ai: Alex 是牙科诊所前台。他以优惠折扣和顺便省时为卖点，热情向你推销美白项目，并试图直接为你安排今天的附加预约。
soc_decline_teeth_whitening.task: 说明自己牙齿较敏感、且今天后续还有个人日程安排，明确拒绝加做美白项目，仅结清洗牙费用。

tgt: Hey guys, the pitch rental was 80 dollars in total today.
It comes out to 8 dollars per person.
Could you please Venmo me when you have a chance? No rush!
traps: 提醒转账不要说 'Give me 8 dollars'，太像打劫。地道说法是 'It's 8 dollars each' 或 'Could you send me your share?'。
租场地不说 'Rent the ground'，足球场用地道词汇 'Pitch' 或 'Field'。
表示算出结果不说 'Calculate out'，地道用法是 'It comes out to...'。
soc_group_soccer_fee.ai: Alex 刚踢完球正在开车，还没来得及看手机，他是个通情达理的人，看到提醒会马上转账。
soc_group_soccer_fee.task: 礼貌地提醒 Alex 和其他人转账，并说明金额是 8 美元。

tgt: Excuse me, could you point me to the red line platform for Harvard?
Do I need to go upstairs or stay on this level to transfer?
Is the train running on schedule, or is there any delay right now?
traps: 说成 'Where is red line? I want to go Harvard.'，漏掉了定冠词和介词，听起来像电报体。地道说法是 'Could you point me to the red line platform for Harvard?'。
说成 'How can I change to another train?'，'change to' 太笼统，地铁换乘通常用 'transfer' 或 'switch to'。地道说法是 'Do I need to transfer to another line?'。
说成 'Is the train late time?'，中式直译。表达晚点或延误地道说法是 'Is the train running on schedule, or is there any delay?'。
life_way_boston_subway_transfer.ai: Alex 扮演地铁站台工作人员。他会先指出你要去的方向需要走地下通道换乘，并提醒你红线目前因为信号维护有 10 分钟的延误，建议你留意广播通知。
life_way_boston_subway_transfer.task: 弄清楚去哈佛大学究竟该走哪个月台，并确认红线是否正常运行。

tgt: I grew up in a beautiful coastal city called Qingdao.
As a kid, I used to collect seashells on the beach every summer.
The sea breeze here really reminds me of my hometown.
traps: 回答来自哪里时说 “My home is in Qingdao”，这指你现在的房子在那里。聊老家/成长地应该用 “I'm originally from...” 或 “I grew up in...”。
把“捡贝壳”说成 “pick up shells”， “pick up” 只是捡起来的动作。表达作为爱好的收集、寻找应该用 “collect seashells” 或 “go shelling”。
表达“让我想起”时用 “makes me remember my hometown”， “remember” 是主动记住。由外物触发联想应该用 “reminds me of”。
talk_memory_taxi_chat.ai: Alex 是个健谈的澳大利亚大叔，很喜欢海边生活，听到你聊起童年，他会好奇地追问。
talk_memory_taxi_chat.task: 告诉司机你来自中国哪个城市，描述它和悉尼相似的地方（靠海），并分享一个童年在海滩玩耍的小故事。

tgt: I am the Head of Tax for the Group's international operations, representing the company in this FY25 audit.
Accompanying me are our specialized tax advisors who managed our transfer pricing documentation.
We are committed to full transparency and providing the necessary substantiation for our intercompany transactions.
traps: 不要说 'I come here to pay tax'，这很不专业。应说 'I am here to represent the company in this tax audit'。
避免说 'We follow the law' 这种废话。地道说法是 'We are fully compliant with the relevant statutory requirements'。
不要说 'This is my assistant'，在正式场合应说 'My colleague [Name], who specializes in...'，赋予团队成员具体的专业身份。
wk_intro_tax_audit_authority.ai: Alex 扮演一名资深的税务局官员。他态度严肃，重点在于你们公司是否合规申报了跨境关联交易。他不需要寒暄，只需要确认你的沟通权限和专业度。
wk_intro_tax_audit_authority.task: 正式自我介绍，并确立作为公司税务发言人的身份，表达配合审计的立场。

tgt: I am so terribly sorry this happened to your precious photos.
Please don't worry about my check-out at all; let me help you lay these out to dry.
Take your time, I'm here to lend a hand with whatever you need.
traps: 说 "Can I still get my deposit back?"（我还能退押金吗？），在别人绝望时提钱极度缺乏同理心，地道表达应为 "Please don't give the house key or check-out a second thought."
说 "It's just old paper, don't cry."（只是些旧纸，别哭了），贬低遗物价值极为失礼，地道表达应为 "These memories are irreplaceable, I completely understand your grief."
说 "You should call a plumber now."（你现在应该叫管道工），在对方哭泣时生硬给指令，地道表达应为 "Would you like me to make that call for you while you sit down?"
soc_comfort_airbnb_host_flooded.ai: Alex 扮演房东。她对珍贵回忆的损毁感到万分悲痛，同时对作为租客的你感到抱歉，觉得给你添了麻烦。
soc_comfort_airbnb_host_flooded.task: 安慰老人的悲伤，表达深切的同情，并主动提出帮忙清理积水或挽救物品。

tgt: The colors in this painting are quite interesting, aren't they?
It’s a bit abstract for me, but I kind of like the vibe.
What do you think of this piece?
traps: 不要说 'The painting is interesting, yes?'，应使用反义疑问句 '...aren't they?'。
不要说 'I don't understand the abstract painting'，可以说 'It's a bit abstract for me'。
不要说 'What is your opinion about this?'，说 'What do you think of this piece?' 更地道。
life_smalltalk_art_gallery.ai: Alex 站在你旁边，他觉得这幅画很有趣，想听听你的看法。
life_smalltalk_art_gallery.task: 分享对画作的直观感受，并反问对方。

tgt: I’m not really familiar enough with the local situation to comment, actually.
I should probably head back to my room to unpack.
I'll leave you to your evening, have a good night!
traps: 说 "I don't care about this" 或 "This is none of my business"，显得冷漠无情。地道表达是 "I’m not really familiar enough with..."，优雅地示弱退场。
直译 "I must go back to my room"。"must" 语气太强硬，像被逼迫，用 "I should probably head back" 更自然。
用 "I don't want to talk" 终结对话，显得有敌意。可以用 "I'll leave you to your evening" 顺势抽身。
talk_end_hotel_neighbor.ai: 扮演 804 住客 Alex。他情绪有些激动，试图拉你当同盟，赞同他的观点。
talk_end_hotel_neighbor.task: 保持中立，礼貌地结束对话并回到自己房间。

tgt: Is there an airport veterinarian on duty who can verify these documents for me?
I have a digital copy with the official seal from the clinic; would that suffice?
What are my options to get this cleared before the gate closes in an hour?
traps: 说 My cat is healthy。这跟文件合规性无关。地道说法是 All the vaccinations are up to date and valid。
说 Please help me, I am crying。过度情绪化。地道说法是 I'm very distressed, is there any workaround for this situation?
说 I didn't know this。无知不是理由。地道说法是 I was under the impression that this documentation was complete。
life_air_pet_travel_error.ai: 地勤主管。他很同情你，但坚持如果没有正确的印章，目的地海关会拒绝入境并罚款航空公司。
life_air_pet_travel_error.task: 询问是否可以联系机场兽医官现场补办，或者提供其他的电子备份文件作为补充证明。

tgt: I'm looking for some second-hand books on yoga philosophy.
Do you happen to have anything by this author in stock?
Is there a section for health and wellness?
traps: 说 'Do you have books about...' 可以，但 'Do you happen to have...' 语气更委婉礼貌。
说 'I am searching for' 显得像警察搜查，用 'I'm looking for' 更自然。
说 'Is there a place for...' 不如说 'Is there a section for...' 专业。
hob_read_secondhand_shop.ai: 老书店店主。他翻了翻书目记录，告诉你店里有一本1995年出版的经典之作。
hob_read_secondhand_shop.task: 询问是否有特定题材的旧书

tgt: She's taken a bad fall — could we get her off the platform and sit her down somewhere?
Have you got a first aid kit? Her knee's bleeding quite a lot.
I know you need to clear the platform. Give me thirty seconds and I'll walk her out myself.
traps: 把中文的「扶」直译成「I will support her to walk」。support 在英语里主要是精神上支持、经济上资助，扶人不这么说。地道的是「Let me give her a hand」「I'll walk her out」，或者直接对老太太说「Here, take my arm.」
「She falled down on the floor」两处错：fall 的过去式是 fell 不是 falled；而且英语里 fall 本身就含倒下的意思，多数时候不加 down，室外也不说 on the floor。说「She's had a fall」或「She tripped and went down.」
当面说「this old woman」很不礼貌，old 用在人身上带贬义。第三人称提到她用「this lady」或「an elderly lady」，跟她本人说话就直接用 you。
life_help_platform_fall.ai: Alex 演站台值班站务员。他先正常关心老太太的伤，同时要保证通道畅通、按流程走：要么叫救护车，要么请人离开站台。他态度是正常的，只是时间压力很大。
life_help_platform_fall.task: 让站务员先把老太太扶到站台外的长椅上、拿来急救包，并说服老太太接受检查，别一瘸一拐自己走掉

tgt: That's really generous, but I'm going straight to bed tonight.
I'd rather not make plans for the rest of the trip — my schedule's all over the place.
I appreciate it, honestly. I just can't.
traps: 别用 'Maybe next time' 收尾又不给具体时间。英语里这句被当成客套的空话，热情的人只会继续追问。要么明确 'I'm not going to be able to,' 要么什么都不许诺。
'I'm afraid of going with a stranger' 说出口很伤人，而且 'I'm afraid' 单用其实是「恐怕」的礼貌套话。换个不带指控的理由：'I've got an early start tomorrow.'
「我有点事」直译成 'I have something to do' 含糊得像敷衍。地道说法是 'I've already got something on tonight.'
soc_decline_driver_dinner.ai: Alex 演司机 Emre，四十来岁，真心热情，自己说了没有任何提成。你说累了，他说吃完九点就送你回来；你说改天，他当场要你的 WhatsApp 想约明天。他一直很客气，只是不接受模糊的答复。
soc_decline_driver_dinner.task: 把今晚和改天两条路一起挡掉，不留任何模糊的约定，也别让他觉得你是在提防他。

tgt: We've gone way over — and that's on me, this was a good one.
I need to head off at six, but same time next week?
Let's save the exam stuff for next time, I want to hear how it goes.
traps: 'The time is over.' / 'Our time is up.' 前者不成句，后者像监考老师宣布交卷。说 'We've gone way over' 或 'I should probably wrap up.'
'Sorry, I must pick up my friend.'——must 又太重，而且没给下一步。说 'I need to head off — I'm picking up a friend at six.'
结束说 'Let's keep in touch.'——对每周都见的人讲这句等于在告别永别，反而疏远。要续约就说具体的：'Same time next week?'
talk_end_langswap_overrun.ai: Alex 演语伴 Lukas，德国人，二十多岁，认真又热情，觉得今天聊得特别好所以完全没看表。他不会介意结束，但你含糊其辞他就会顺手开下一个话题。
talk_end_langswap_overrun.task: 十分钟内把这次收掉，定下下周的时间，并且不让他觉得你嫌他啰嗦。

tgt: My grandma raised me from when I was three until about eleven.
My parents worked in another city, so I'd only see them twice a year, usually at Chinese New Year.
It sounds sad but it didn't feel that way at the time — a lot of kids in my school were in the same situation.
traps: 「带大」别直译成 "My grandmother brought me up big." —— bring up 本身就含「养大」，后面不加 big。说 "My grandma raised me" 或 "My grandma brought me up."
别说 "My parents worked in other place, one year see two times." —— 缺冠词、动词也没变位。完整说法是 "My parents worked in another city and I only saw them twice a year."
别说 "I very miss her." —— very 不能直接修饰动词。说 "I miss her a lot" 或 "I really miss her."
talk_memory_langex_grandma.ai: 语伴 Alex，在学中文，想听真实的中国生活是什么样。会好奇你当时想不想爸妈、奶奶常做什么给你吃，也会讲自己的成长经历，是双向交流不是采访。
talk_memory_langex_grandma.task: 把这段成长经历讲清楚——谁带你、为什么、当时什么感受——再问对方一个对等的问题。

tgt: What did you think? I read it completely differently.
For me, the fact that he puts his coat down means he stays.
I guess it's meant to be left open.
traps: 「你觉得呢」说成 "How do you think?" —— 要说 "What did you think?" / "What's your take on it?"
「开放式结局」说成 "It's an open end" —— 要说 "an open ending"，或 "the ending's left open" / "it's ambiguous."
「我不这么认为」说成 "I think it's not like that." —— 绕。地道的是 "I read it differently." / "That's not how I saw it."
talk_movie_lobby_ending.ai: Alex 是刚看完同一场的陌生观众，兴致勃勃，愿意听你怎么看，也会拿片子里的细节来反驳你。
talk_movie_lobby_ending.task: 说出你对结局的理解和依据，听懂他的不同看法，最后一起承认这就是个开放式结局。

tgt: I left my laptop bag on the train arriving from Schiphol at 2 PM.
Could you check the lost and found database for this train line?
How can I be notified if the item is recovered?
traps: 常说 'I left my laptop on the train station'，应为 'on the train'，'at the station'。
说 'Please call me' 显得生硬，地道说法是 'How can I be reached if it’s found?'。
误用 'Can you help me to find?'，直接说 'Could you help me locate my bag?' 更简洁。
life_lost_laptop_train.ai: 车站失物招领处工作人员。协助记录车次和丢失时间，并在系统里查询是否已有列车乘务员登记拾获物。
life_lost_laptop_train.task: 向工作人员描述电脑特征，并留下联系方式以便后续跟进。

tgt: You just can't find this level of leather quality in high-street stores.
It's a unique vintage piece, so nobody else will be wearing the exact same thing.
The real leather and patina only get better with age.
traps: 把‘二手/古着’错说成 'old clothes'（带破旧贬义），地道用词是 'vintage piece' 或 'pre-owned item'。
把皮衣‘质感’直译为 'skin texture'，表达皮质或做工地道用 'leather quality' 或 'craftsmanship'。
说 'Zara is cheap material' 显得生硬，表达质量差异地道说法是 'High-street quality just doesn't compare'.
talk_shopop_paris_leather.ai: Alex 扮演住在巴黎的当地朋友。他性格务实，觉得买二手衣比新衣还贵很难理解，听你分享独特的审美和消费观。
talk_shopop_paris_leather.task: 向 Alex 解释二手古着皮衣的独特性与材质价值，说明你为什么觉得这 220 欧元花得很值。

tgt: The killer is camping the hook, let's finish this gen first.
You go for the unhook, I'll stick to the generator.
We need to pop this last gen to open the gates.
traps: 不要说 "Fix the machine"，游戏里特指发电机 "generator"，简称为 "gen"。
不要说 "Save the man from the wood"，被挂起来的地方叫 "hook"。
避免说 "The killer is staying there"，杀手守尸的术语是 "camping"。
hob_video_dbd_hook.ai: 队友 Alex，他正和你一起修最后一台电机。他显得很犹豫，想去救人但又怕被抓。
hob_video_dbd_hook.task: 告诉 Alex 先把这台电机修完，再去合力救人，或者让他去救，你留下来修机。

tgt: We specifically ordered the steak set menu to celebrate my cousin's college graduation.
None of our guests were informed about this menu change in advance.
Could you check if you can source some seafood alternatives of equal value?
traps: 说成 'You did not tell me before.'，‘before’ 放在句尾不够地道，应说 'in advance' 或 'ahead of time'。
说成 'My cousin cannot eat chicken.' 表达不够客气，表述某人不吃某种食物可以说 'My cousin is not a fan of chicken' 或 'doesn't eat chicken'。
说成 'Change the food for us now.' 语气太冲，地道表达应为 'Could you please offer us another option like seafood?'
soc_congrats_graduation_party_menu.ai: Alex 是餐厅值班经理。他耸耸肩解释说今天由于供应链问题高级牛肉没能按时运到，所以只能统一换成鸡肉。
soc_congrats_graduation_party_menu.task: 明确告知表弟不吃鸡肉且今天是庆祝毕业，要求餐厅立刻从其他渠道或附近采购牛排，或者提供同等价值的海鲜替代方案。

tgt: I make one cup in the morning with a pour-over, no milk — does that justify the twenty-two-dollar bag?
I don't mind paying more if I can actually taste the difference.
Maybe I'll start with something in the middle and work my way up.
traps: 别说 "This coffee is very delicious." —— delicious 用在咖啡上偏书面、也偏用力。母语者说 "It tastes great." "It's really smooth." "It's got a nice fruity note."
别说 "I drink coffee by myself at home." 来表达「我自己煮咖啡」 —— by myself 是「独自」，意思跑偏了。说 "I make my own coffee at home." 或 "I brew it at home."
别说 "It's not cost-effective for me." —— 这是商业报告的词，聊天里太硬。日常说 "I'm not sure it's worth it for me." 或 "That feels like a lot for what I'd get out of it."
talk_shopop_coffee_beans.ai: Alex 是这家店的咖啡师，跟你已经眼熟了。他不急着推销，先问你在家用什么冲、平时喝多浓，然后老实说：如果你只是早上加牛奶喝一杯，这包豆子的钱可能花得有点浪费。
talk_shopop_coffee_beans.task: 说清楚你在家怎么喝咖啡、想要什么口感，让他帮你判断这 22 美元花得值不值，最后决定买哪一包。
